## Description

Combines deep reinforcement learning policy gradient optimization with behavioral cloning from human-expert execution trajectories (e.g., TWAP/VWAP baselines) to stabilize training and minimize execution cost.

## Where it may fit

Institutional block order execution, illiquid asset liquidation, minimizing market impact.

## Vehicles

Agency execution brokers, algorithmic trading desks, institutional asset managers.

## Required data

Historical execution logs, order book depth, intraday volume profiles, arrival prices.

## Caveats

Relies on high-quality expert demonstration datasets; policy drift can occur if market microstructure changes rapidly.
